units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Kings 14:4">Targ. I Kings XIV, 4</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:1:7">Y. Ned. IX, 41ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>עיני כַּהֲיָיא</he> my eye-sight is failing.

<cite ref="Yoma 69b">Yoma 69ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 64a">Snh. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>כַּהֲיִינְהוּ לעיניה</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="K00468"><he>כחלינהו</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="K00048"><he>כְּבִי</he></cite>) they made his eye-sight dim. Ib. 27ᵃ <he>ליכַהֲיוּהוּ לעיניה</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80) he shall be blinded.

senses.gloss: (sub. לִבֵּיה) to be angry; (with ב־ of person) to rebuke.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 3:13">Targ. I Sam. III, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 32:7">Targ. Ez. XXXII, 7</cite> <he>באַכְהָיוּתִי</he> when I make dim (h. text <he>בכבותך</he>).

senses.gloss: to make the heart faint, to annoy, reproach (falsely). Ib. XIII, 22 אַכְהֵיתִין לב וכ׳ ye denounced the heart of the righteous to be false (h. text הכאות).
